model.growth: Repeat the observed 2025-to-2026 ratio as a scenario, not a forecast

revision_10.evidence: DESIGN (b81 economy lane DESIGN.txt; coordinator rulings 2026-11-25); real yardsticks PROVED by economy/ec_real.py

price.rule: price = price_scale x market_curve[group](rank) x cap; rank = 1 + rostered men of the group rated above him + half of those level with him (0x246D80 unboosted, whole points); then the aging rule and the minimum
price.price_scale_note: 2026-11-25 (coordinator): 0.8 left a median 19.6% of the cap unspent in panel 74001-74004 and the 99th-percentile deal at 8.9% (gates E1, E3); 1.0 in panel 74001-74004 (retune) left 6.4% (band 1.5-5%) with the 99th percentile at 11.05%: 1.05
price.source: nflverse historical_contracts.parquet (OverTheCap), each active player's latest deal, apy_cap_pct of the k-th best-paid at the position (OTC S = FS+SS, LB = OLB+ILB, LT/RT = T, LG/RG = G, IDL = DT, ED = DE); downloaded 2026-11-25; a missing rank repeats the last known one

aging.note: the decline_after_years_pro rule restated by age (a first-year player is about 22); to be replaced by the league-aging lane's D_TARGET turning ages when relayed

asks.note: a free agent's ask falls with the weeks he goes unsigned (+0x25 bits 5-7); from the camp stage (6) at most half his price; in season (stage 8+) a quarter of it; never below his minimum

lengths.source: nflverse historical_contracts contract_history, deals signed 2022-2025 of types UFA, SFA, ERFA, RFA, Extension, Franchise, Transition; age from nflverse players.csv birth_date (economy/real.txt R3)

reserve.permille_note: retune 2026-11-25 (coordinator, one round): trimmed from 20 25 30 35 40 50 85 130 so that at price scale 1.0 the median room lands in 1.5-5% (static estimate from panel 74001-74004 at scale 1.0 with the old reserve: 5.2%, 44.5% of clubs at 7.6%+)
reserve.source: OverTheCap in-season cap space read 2026-11-25 (median 2.9% of the cap, 7 of 32 clubs at 7.6%+, p10 1.3%, most 13.2%) plus about 1% for in-season minimum signings (159 a league-season)

cap_growth.source: official caps 2011 $120.0M, 2016 $155.27M, 2019 $188.2M, 2024 $255.4M (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salary_cap, read 2026-11-25), 2026 $301.2M (this file's cap source): compound 6.33% a year 2011-2026, 6.85% 2016-2026 (coordinator ruling 5)
